findings.title: Pass the user to isConditionalPasskeysEnabled
findings.body: This calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() without arguments, but the method added to UsernamePasswordForm requires a UserModel argument. There is no zero-argument overload in the supplied hierarchy, so UsernameForm does not compile and the services module cannot build. Pass context.getUser() to the helper.

findings.title: Keep conditional passkeys enabled before a user is identified
findings.body: The new helper requires user != null, but ordinary login starts with context.getUser() == null. Both authenticate() and the error challenge now use this helper, so they no longer call fillContextForm() during ordinary username/password or username-only login. Consequently, the initial page lacks the conditional WebAuthn UI and challenge, breaking discoverable-passkey login and the existing tests that expect passkeys before entering a username. The predicate must support unidentified users as well as re-authentication.
